plan.title: SRC-PR-044 — Create Single-Stage RFP from Asset PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Assert that the event has exactly one RFP stage.
Assert that the PR quantity is shown on the create screen.
Assert that the PR unit is shown on the create screen.
Assert that the technical RFP create screen does not expose a pricing column.
Add the two vendors named by the case.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Assert that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
